description: Nestled in this sought-after Encino enclave, this beautifully maintained 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom residence offers 1469sqft of abundant natural light with a warm inviting ambiance. The open concept, serene, landscaped backyard is an ideal setting for intimate indoor-outdoor living. The backyard is gated for privacy and security, featuring well maintained landscaping with lush greenery and beautiful blooms year-round. Lovingly cared for and impeccably maintained, the home also features a newly installed furnace and brand-new dishwasher. Located in a tranquil neighborhood known for its safety and charm you can enjoy refined living in one of Encino's most desirable settings. Clean, accessible sidewalks offer a perfect environment for families taking a stroll through the friendly neighborhood. Instant access to the 405 freeway are some of the perks of living here, not to mention top tier schools and walking distance to restaurants and entertainment. **All Offers Due 5/23/26 at 5pm PST. **
